description: Validator-native fixed8 price oracle with strict stake quorum, five-minute slot freshness, commit-reveal randomness, and bounded multi-attester data proofs. Price-feeder mutations are legacy genesis-only operations once consensus-managed mode is active.

functions.name: initialize_oracle
functions.description: Initializes the contract once; the transaction signer must equal owner_ptr.

functions.name: add_price_feeder
functions.description: Legacy genesis-only feeder authorization. Returns code 7 after consensus-managed mode is active.

functions.name: set_authorized_attester
functions.description: Owner-only authorization for the separate bounded data-attestation subsystem.

functions.name: submit_price
functions.description: Legacy genesis-only fixed8 price submission. Returns code 22 after consensus-managed mode is active; live prices are finalized by the native validator oracle.

functions.name: get_price
functions.description: Writes price u64, source slot u64, and decimals u8. Returns 1 on success, 2 for stale/future/noncanonical data, and 0 when absent.

functions.name: get_price_value
functions.description: Cross-contract canonical quote lookup. Sets 17-byte return_data on success: fixed8 price (u64 LE), consensus source slot (u64 LE), and decimals (u8, exactly 8); returns 2 for stale, future, or noncanonical data.

functions.name: commit_randomness
functions.description: Commits H(requester || secret || seed) for deterministic post-commit block entropy.

functions.name: reveal_randomness
functions.description: Reveals the committed secret after a later block entropy slot and writes random value u64 plus entropy slot u64.

functions.name: request_randomness
functions.description: Deprecated insecure one-step randomness entrypoint; always fails closed.

functions.name: get_randomness
functions.description: Returns only the result bound to the exact requester and seed; no cross-seed fallback is allowed.

functions.name: submit_attestation
functions.description: Submits a hash-bound payload of at most 32 bytes from an owner-authorized attester; duplicate attesters are rejected.

functions.name: verify_attestation
functions.description: Returns 1 only when the stored proof has at least min_signatures distinct authorized attesters.

functions.name: get_attestation_data
functions.description: Writes signature count u8, source slot u64, and the exact 32-byte zero-padded attested payload.

functions.name: query_oracle
functions.description: Compatibility query router for price, random, and attestation lookups.

functions.name: get_aggregated_price
functions.description: Returns the already-finalized native stake-weighted median in the legacy price-plus-count shape; num_feeds must be nonzero but does not trigger a second aggregation.

functions.name: get_oracle_stats
functions.description: Writes compatibility query, legacy feed, and bounded attestation counters as three little-endian u64 values.

functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Alias of initialize_oracle.

functions.name: register_feed
functions.description: Alias of legacy add_price_feeder; disabled after consensus-managed activation.

functions.name: get_feed_count
functions.description: Returns the legacy compatibility feed count, not native consensus feed health.

functions.name: get_feed_list
functions.description: Returns the legacy compatibility feed count in return_data.

functions.name: add_reporter
functions.description: Legacy reporter metadata operation; disabled with code 7 in consensus-managed mode and does not authorize native price publication.

functions.name: remove_reporter
functions.description: Legacy reporter metadata operation; disabled with code 7 in consensus-managed mode.

functions.name: set_update_interval
functions.description: Legacy feeder interval in slots, bounded to 1..750; disabled with code 7 in consensus-managed mode.

functions.name: mo_pause
functions.description: Owner-only pause for legacy submissions and bounded data attestations; native price health reports paused until resumed.

functions.name: mo_unpause
functions.description: Owner-only resume for bounded data attestations and legacy mode where applicable.
